faq.title: Questions we often get.
faq.desc: If your question is not on this list, just ask us directly on WhatsApp.
faq.supportDesc: Our team is ready to answer — 24/7.
faq.q1: Does Baba Solution install WiFi at home?
faq.a1: Yes. We install WiFi and internet for homes, offices, schools, and public areas — with signal coverage measured and guaranteed throughout the space.
faq.q2: How long does building a website take?
faq.a2: A company profile website usually takes 1–3 weeks depending on complexity. The exact timeline is given in writing before the project starts.
faq.q3: Is there a warranty for laptop and PC repair?
faq.a3: Yes. Every repair job comes with a written warranty — covering the labor and replacement parts under the agreed terms.
faq.q4: Can you build a computer laboratory for schools?
faq.a4: Yes. We handle the full package — room layout, LAN installation, servers, racks, cabling, and training on how to use it.
faq.q5: How do I order a service?
faq.a5: Reach us through the contact form, email, or WhatsApp. We reply for an initial consultation and a clear quote.
